sources.entry: Mate Translate - Translate in Safari and any app on macOS between 103 languages.

summary.name: Mate Translate
summary.one_liner: Mate is a macOS menu bar translation app with a Safari extension that translates selected text in any app, supporting 248 languages.
use_cases: Translate selected text in Safari, Mail, Notes, or PDFs
Look up translations from the menu bar without opening a separate translator
Learn vocabulary by translating Netflix subtitles
Keep a personal phrasebook of translated phrases
View phonetics and noun genders while learning a language
summary.what_it_does: Mate is a translation app for Mac that sits in the menu bar and pops up a translation window when called, then disappears. It includes a built-in Safari extension and works with other apps for selected-text translation. It supports 248 languages according to the page. Users can customize keyboard shortcuts, view phonetics, transliteration and noun genders, and organize a personal phrasebook that syncs across devices. It also integrates with PopClip and can translate Netflix subtitles.
notable: Menu bar app with Safari extension and selected-text translation in any app
Works with PopClip and translates Netflix subtitles
Phrasebook with cross-device sync, phonetics and noun genders
caveats: Pro features and some functions appear to require payment; a full-week trial is mentioned
Users report a keyboard shortcut not working on macOS Sequoia
Users report a missing country flag display and a request for a history-disable toggle
